headline: The Islamabad High Court on Tuesday ordered authorities to arrange a one-hour jail meeting within two days between Imran Khan, Bushra Bibi and their lawyers in the £190 million case, and adjourned the appeals for 10 days.

card.desc: Authorities must arrange it within two days.

caption:
Imran Khan's lawyers to get a one-hour jail meeting!
According to The Express Tribune, the Islamabad High Court on Tuesday ordered authorities to arrange a one-hour jail meeting within two days between PTI founder Imran Khan, his wife Bushra Bibi and their lawyers, Salman Safdar and Latif Khosa, in the £190 million case. The court adjourned the appeals for 10 days and told the lawyers to start their arguments at the next hearing.
